none: PAS SUSS-A50F08: Sestercius of Marcus Aurelius
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A very worn Roman Sestercius of Marcus Aurelius (161-180 AD). Reece Period 8. Mint unknown. The obverse is extremely worn, but depicts a bust facing right. The reverse seems to depict Jupiter seated left, holding attributes. For two similar examples, cf.: RIC III, p285, No. 916 (c. Dec. 165-Summer 166); p292, No. 988 (c. Dec. 170-Dec. 171) .
